summary: The October 28, 2025 patch added postgres_extra_settings to the AAP operators so you can apply PostgreSQL configuration-file-level changes to the operator-managed postgres (AAP-55053).
questions: How do I change postgresql.conf settings for operator-managed PostgreSQL?
What is postgres_extra_settings in the AAP operator?
Can I tune max_connections on the AAP operator database?

answer_card.title: Tune managed PostgreSQL with postgres_extra_settings
answer_card.answer_md: Since the October 28, 2025 patch, the AAP operators accept `postgres_extra_settings`, which applies PostgreSQL configuration-file-level settings to the **operator-managed** postgres instance (AAP-55053).
